policy: Only discrepancies supported by current source/provenance records are tracked here. Do not close an item from visual intuition alone; require a matching deterministic capture plus authoritative geometry or lawful reference evidence.

findings.evidence: photo_match_views.json marks the benchmark camera provisional
findings.action: Geolocate or independently constrain the reference viewpoint, then regenerate the deterministic capture before claiming photo-match alignment.

findings.evidence: realism_pass1.json states facade colour/window pattern is not parcel-specific yet
findings.action: Replace generic facade shader rules on hero-visible buildings with parcel/building-specific reference-backed facade proportions and material classes.

findings.evidence: realism_pass1.json states lamp/furniture lateral offsets and spacing are photo-guided rather than surveyed
findings.action: Prefer official/open furniture positions where available; otherwise preserve uncertainty and validate spacing against orthophoto/street reference before promotion.

findings.action: Capture gate is satisfied; keep the capture deterministic and address the remaining visual mismatches below before benchmark promotion.

findings.evidence: reference states view from Atomium but exact observation point/lens pose is not known and no matching capture is registered
findings.action: Choose an explicitly provisional Atomium observation camera, match broad stadium/Heysel alignment, and record remaining uncertainty instead of inferring photographer GPS.

findings.evidence: 355 of 9518 official building footprints still use the documented 10.5 m fallback
findings.action: Prioritize fallback buildings visible from hero views and replace fallback heights only when better DSM/LiDAR/source coverage supports the change.

findings.evidence: palais5_nearest_urbis_audit.json identifies one containing UrbIS component around the Palais 5 semantic locator, but its campus-scale span/area fails the anti-false-positive hero-footprint screen and resolution_status remains needs_finer_authoritative_geometry
findings.action: Keep the broad UrbIS Expo geometry as context only. Resolve Palais 5 from finer authoritative geometry or another lawful, explicitly documented source before using a hall-specific footprint in hero-view validation.

findings.evidence: The first source-geolocated Godot capture at the provisional 50 degree FOV shows the Atomium occupying much less of the image than the lawful 960x638 reference. The source metadata does not publish focal length, so the current FOV cannot be treated as source-derived.
findings.action: Measure source and in-game landmark image-space bounds and solve a documented benchmark framing/FOV calibration while preserving that it is a visual-fit parameter, not recovered EXIF focal length.

findings.evidence: The lawful reference visibly includes the large fountain basin/water jets, dense flanking tree walls, lamp posts, parked cars, benches and pedestrians. The first deterministic in-game capture instead shows broad simplified ground/road surfaces and sparse generic context.
findings.action: Resolve the fountain/open-space footprint and hero-visible vegetation/furniture from authoritative or lawful sources, then rebuild the foreground before claiming realism completion.

findings.evidence: The first deterministic capture shows simplified flat road/ground materials, coarse tree forms and generic facade blocks, while the reference contains reflective Atomium metal, detailed vegetation, paved foreground, vehicles and street furniture.
findings.action: Prioritize hero-view material/vegetation/detail replacement using source-backed classes and measured placement; do not hide the mismatch with generic clutter.
